entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Chris. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return something. This VeloBand Pulse tracker is not what I expected at all. I just want my money back.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?
Ugh, one second. It's VF98765432. Just send me the return label.
Thank you. Pulling that up now... Okay, I see the VeloBand Pulse. And it looks like it was delivered to you... 11 days ago. Is that correct?
Yeah, 11 days, 10 days, whatever. I've been busy. It doesn't work for me.

I understand. The thing is, I'm seeing a flag here in the system. The VeloBand Pulse, because it's a sensitive electronic device, has a strict 10-day return policy. Our standard 90-day policy doesn't apply to this specific item.
You cannot be serious. One day? You're going to deny my return over one single day? That's an absolutely absurd policy!

I do apologize for the frustration. The policy is listed on the product page, but I know it's easy to miss. Unfortunately, the system automatically locks the order and prevents me from generating a return label after the 10-day mark.
So I'm just stuck with this? Unacceptable. I want to talk to your supervisor right now.
Look... between you and me, you're right, it's a ridiculous reason to lose a customer. I'm not really supposed to do this, and honestly, my **manager would kill me** if she found out.
What are you saying?
I'm saying... give me a moment. I'm going to try to **override the system** and force the return through. Just please understand, this is strictly a **one-time exception**.
You can do that? Well, yeah, do it.
Okay... one second... clicking through a few warnings here... Okay! It went through. I've just sent the prepaid return label to the email on file. You should have it in the next few minutes.
Wow. I... I honestly didn't think you'd do that. Thank you so much. I was getting ready for a huge fight.
It's no problem at all. We want to make sure you're taken care of. Just get that shipped back to us, and we'll process your full refund as soon as it arrives at the warehouse.
That's great, Chris. You really turned this around. I appreciate it.
I'm happy I could help. Is there anything else for you today?
Nope, that's it. Thanks again!
You're very welcome. Enjoy the rest of your day, and thank you for calling VeloFit.
